_meta.keying: OPTION TITLE (event_id lags transitions in mod state)

Read the Back.note: Sharp 2 (+dmg/hit) on an Attack; SB 8.2. Owner: beats Swift-Power only with a 3x+ multi-hit target — the enchant target picker prefers multi-hits.

Read a Random Passage.note: Nimble 2 on a Skill; SB 8.5; owner: Nimble > Sharp generally.

Read the Entire Book.note: Swift 2 on a Power (owner: first play each combat draws 2 — powers get played once, so this is 2 draw every combat it's cast).

Rip the Leech Off.note: 5 HP for a Colorless card reward; owner took it in A/B #2-era play, Spirebird agrees.

Immerse.note: +2 Max HP for 3 damage — great rate; loop.

Linger.note: +2 Max HP for 4 damage; keep looping.

Abstain.note: Heal 10; take only when the HP math flips.

That.note: Random relic + Clumsy; relics are deck power and Clumsy is a mild curse.

Search.note: 14 HP for the Chosen Cheese relic — seen in two win decks; pay it.

Devour.note: Title alias of 'Search' (same Chosen Cheese option; the event uses both). Owner-QA'd correct pick.

Gorge.note: 2 of 8 commons; deck bloat vs selection.

Nab the Map.note: Spoils Map = 600g at the Act-3 main chest; we protect it from removal and exhaust it freely (7f0a0c6). Real EV if the run goes deep; the router likes gold now.

Bathe.note: Wellspring heal-ish option; Spirebird carried it.

Snake.note: REVERSED 2026-07-20 (owner + SB 11.9): Slither = random 0-3 cost on draw — positive EV stapled to any cost>=2 card, and Ironclad always has Bash. The old 'Slither trap' anchor was a TARGETING mistake (a cost-1 Strike), not a bad option; the enchant target picker now takes the highest-cost card.

Bird.note: Starter -> Peck; SB 5.0. Owner: Toric usually better; Peck edges it with Strength gain in deck OR Vantom as the boss.

Torus.note: Starter -> Toric Toughness; SB 9.5; owner: usually the pick.

Second Chest.note: 300-360g + Greed curse. Big income for one curse; gold converts well since the late-shop loop.

Climb.note: Fresnel Lens for -13 Max HP — steep.

Observe.note: Spiral = Replay 1 on a basic (mediocre -> decent); SB 15.3 and owner agree. Planner prices the Replay text correctly (verified: Strike+Spiral parses 6x2).

Grab Spicy Snappy off the Belt.note: 40g for a random upgrade + the loop continues.

Insert Common Potion.note: Sacrifice the tier's potion for a same-rarity card reward (declinable cards, event NOT declinable).

Insert Uncommon Potion.note: Owner: higher rarity better, unless the potion is protected-class (see EVENTS_PASS).

Insert Rare Potion.note: Owner: highest rarity is the default pick; protected-potion veto is a potion-pass item.

Fight!.note: Optional fight for loot; deck-power dependent.

Solo Quest.note: ~148g for 18 HP — big income, real cost.

Capture the Wisp.note: Lost Wisp relic (seen in a win deck).

Decipher.note: -3 Max HP for one random upgrade — poor rate.

Reach Deeper.note: Deeper for 5 HP; chain EV positive-ish.

Slowly Find an Exit.note: 8 HP for one random potion — meh.

Keep the Key.note: Fight for the Key (hp-gated); pays off at the first Act-3 '?' with a top-tier relic. Owner: real difference-maker if the run gets there.

Accept.note: The Decider is NOT declinable (Reject loops then ends the run). Sub-choices per owner: 2-relics > Shame-upgrade; Regret+300g > heal-10 (unless desperate / no shops left); Doubt+2-rewards vs Double+Transform-2 by basics count.
